paras: The Alpha-N Carbon Front Fender Set — V2 with Blades is designed to fit the BMW M2 G87 2023+, and is available in Australia through iilumolab. Developed and manufactured in Germany by Alpha-N Performance, a brand with deep roots in BMW motorsport, this lightweight fender set delivers a motorsport-inspired aerodynamic upgrade while introducing an aggressive aesthetic to the front of the G87.

Inspired by modern GT racing aero concepts, the V2 fenders incorporate integrated carbon aero blades positioned ahead of the doors. These blade elements help guide air exiting the front wheel wells along the body side, reducing pressure buildup inside the fender area while contributing to improved aerodynamic balance — mirroring airflow management strategies seen on high-performance motorsport vehicles.
hl: Manufactured in Germany by Alpha-N Performance
Pre-preg 2x2 twill carbon fibre, sourced from Italy
Integrated aero blades for improved front-corner airflow
Significant weight reduction over factory steel fenders
Ships in raw carbon — requires professional paint preparation or clear coat prior to installation
